description: Rhea is deciding whether to swap her vintage drum machine for a neighbor's synthesizer, and must settle the exact equipment, pickup arrangement, and setup help with input from the neighbor and a bandmate.

agents.name: Rhea
agents.role: Drum Machine Owner and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Rhea owns a vintage drum machine and has said she would consider an informal swap for a compact synthesizer.
shared_context.S2: Cal has expressed interest in trading equipment with Rhea.
shared_context.S3: June regularly helps Rhea prepare and test gear for band projects.
shared_context.S4: Rhea's usual gear-swap routine is to have the owner spell out every item and service included and to check with June for any band schedule deadline before she finalizes.

PF1.text: Cal's complete offer is his Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer, its original power adapter, and its soft case, with pickup on Friday at 6:00 p.m.; he will also provide a 30-minute setup session.

PF2.text: June learned from Rhea's bandmate Omar, who has not told Rhea yet, that Rhea's band is recording on Sunday and needs the replacement synthesizer in hand by Saturday at noon.

acceptance_conditions: The swap must be accepted for the Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer.
The original power adapter and soft case must be included.
Pickup must be scheduled for Friday, with the originally offered 6:00 p.m. time or an explicitly agreed earlier 4:00 p.m. time.
Cal must provide a 30-minute setup session.
The synthesizer must be in Rhea's hands by Saturday at noon.
The Saturday-noon requirement must be credited to June's disclosed information.
Cal's complete offer must be cited as the source of the equipment, accessories, pickup time, and setup terms.

content_checks.C1: decisions['swap_accepted'] == True and decisions['item_received'] in ['Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer', 'Korg Minilogue XD', 'Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer (compact 4-voice analog synth)', 'Korg Minilogue XD (compact 4-voice analog synth)']
content_checks.C2: ('original power adapter' in decisions['accessories'] or 'Original power adapter' in decisions['accessories']) and ('soft case' in decisions['accessories'] or 'Soft case' in decisions['accessories'])
content_checks.C3: decisions['setup_session_included'] == True or any('setup session' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C4: decisions['pickup_time'] in ['Friday at 6:00 p.m.', 'Friday at 6 p.m.', 'Friday at 6:00 PM', 'Friday at 6 PM', 'Friday 6:00 p.m.', 'Friday 6 p.m.'] or (decisions['pickup_time'] in ['Friday at 4:00 p.m.', 'Friday at 4 p.m.', 'Friday at 4:00 PM', 'Friday at 4 PM', 'Friday 4:00 p.m.', 'Friday 4 p.m.'] and any(c['type'] == 'pickup_agreement' and c['target'] == 'Cal' and c['detail'] == 'Cal agreed to Friday at 4:00 p.m. pickup' for c in commitments))

decisive_facts.why: Cal's complete offer changes the unidentified possible swap into a Korg Minilogue XD with the exact original power adapter, soft case, Friday pickup terms, and 30-minute setup session, and only that disclosed offer supports P2.

June's formal schedule confirmation changes the delivery requirement from no stated deadline to having the synthesizer in hand by the exact time of Saturday at noon, and supplies the fact Rhea must cite for that deadline.
